title: Landau-Ginzburg models of generalised Dubrovin-Zhang form and pole collision: Dynkin-type A
summary: In arXiv:1711.05958, arXiv:2103.12673, the authors derive one-dimensional Landau-Ginzburg mirrors of Dubrovin-Zhang Frobenius manifolds constructed on regular orbit spaces of an extension of affine Weyl groups. We generalise the method employed, and classify the resulting Frobenius manifold structures in Dynkin type A. We interpret our results in terms of a stratification on the Hurwitz space boundary, and develop a pole-collision framework to compare the Frobenius structures within different strata.
